Two worked solutions contain intermediate errors: q-164273 changes the denominator of the y term from 3 to 4, and q-35596 changes y²/4 to y²/2. Their final answers remain correct; these errors do not create answer disagreements. For q-72303 and q-164273, the saddle points are the coordinate shifts (1,-4,5) and (3,-1,-4). For q-164279, setting y=0 gives z=x²/2-5. For q-35931, setting x=0 gives z=(y-1)²/3. For q-159579, incrementing x alone gives the selected difference quotient, regardless of the logarithm base. For q-159589, incrementing y alone gives the selected difference quotient, equivalent to -3x²/(y+2)^4. Treating y as constant gives q-159618: 3x²/y⁴+6y and q-159614: -2cos(x). For q-159600, f_x=2√y-2y/√x, yielding -4 at (1,4). For q-159587, f_y=2y√x-x/y², yielding 7 at (4,2). The cone centers in q-176834 and q-94609 are (3,-2,1) and (1,4,0). For q-35620, z=-2 gives (x+4)²/16+y²/6=1, so the major axis length is 8. For q-35596, x=0 gives y²/4=(z-4)², hence z=±y/2+4. For q-20966, x=-1+y-4z with y and z arbitrary gives the selected vector expression. For q-73953, the last row asserts 0=10, so no solution exists. No earlier submitted answer or captured grade was supplied; all MA evidence below comes from the worked solutions.",
